description: This PHP script handles the display of detailed information for a Role in the SuiteCRM system. It manages access control, loads role data, processes the detail view, and renders the HTML template with role details and associated modules.

classes.name: DetailView
classes.description: Class responsible for processing the display of detailed information for a bean, including navigation and rendering.

classes.name: TemplateGroupChooser
classes.description: Class handling the display of module permission assignment interfaces within the role detail view.

classes.name: TabController
classes.description: Class managing tab-based UI components for module settings.

classes.name: SubPanelTiles
classes.description: Class responsible for generating subpanel sections within the role detail view.

methods.name: processSugarBean
methods.description: Method to process and retrieve a specific Bean object based on the type and request parameters.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Method to obtain a brief summary string of the Role bean.

methods.name: query_modules
methods.description: Method to retrieve modules associated with the role, based on permission type.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Method to generate HTML output for the module permission chooser UI.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Method to generate HTML for the subpanel display.
